rationale.agntcy.A2: OASF 1.0 integration/a2a card_data carries executable supportedInterfaces discovered through the official Directory Store/Search/Pull APIs.
rationale.agntcy.B2: OASF 1.0 integration/a2a card_data carries ordered binding/version alternatives that select the actual A2A SDK request path.
rationale.agntcy.C1: The audited local Directory daemon is insecure-mode only; no OIDC/SPIFFE identity-policy execution is available for a formal C1 counterpart.
rationale.autogen.A3: AutoGen AgentChat 0.7.5 natively saves and loads agent state across identities.
rationale.autogen.B1: Removed from the benchmark: SelectorGroupChat selector_func overrides model selection, so the previous implementation did not exercise candidate filtering.
rationale.autogen.C1: A registered AutoGen agent receives the native sensitive message attempt before the deterministic trusted policy records completion.
rationale.autogen.C2: A registered AutoGen agent emits a native MultiModalMessage evaluated against the unchanged Host output decision.
rationale.langgraph.A3: LangGraph 1.2.9 persists graph state in an official InMemorySaver checkpoint keyed by thread_id and resumes it after an identity change.
rationale.langgraph.B1: LangGraph 1.2.9 uses an official conditional edge to route the request to one registered participant node.
rationale.langgraph.C1: A compiled LangGraph routes the selected sensitive action into a node before the deterministic application authorization policy is evaluated.
rationale.langgraph.C2: A compiled LangGraph emits a langchain-core AIMessage containing a native image content block evaluated against the unchanged Host output decision.
